title: Builder Panel Docking Slot

oracle.positive: Reserve Builder docking slot below Projects without creating a second Builder model
oracle.negative: Absent Builder implementation shows noninteractive placeholder

reviewer.role: project owner (human reviewer) running the app on Windows

checks_run: RED: cargo test -p om9-app --test builder_slot -> 7 passed; 2 failed. The one product defect: a stored layout document could float, hide, collapse or move the reserved BUILDERS area, breaking the reservation after a reopen. (The second failure was a weakness in the test's own source scan and was fixed in the test.)
GREEN: cargo test -p om9-app --test builder_slot -> 9 passed; 0 failed (B1..B6, Y1..Y5)
cargo test -p om9-app --lib: 83 passed; cargo test --workspace -j 2: every group ok; cargo check --workspace --all-targets: exit 0
cargo fmt --check: exit 0; cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings: exit 0

real window: om9.exe --ui-audit leaves the reserved area last in the left column with builder_slot_visible=true (OM9-L4-01-01-008-04.integration.log, screenshot builders-in-a-real-window.png); L3-002 size matrix 14/14 PASS; L3-003 panel scenarios 7/7 PASS
code_change: dock_layout.rs::normalize now repairs a stored document that tries to move (dock right), float, hide, collapse or place the reserved BUILDERS area above the Project Manager: it is put back in the left column below Projects with the diagnostic 'Builders is reserved for builder tools; the area was restored below the Project Manager'. The check runs on the document's own values, before the density pass renumbers a column for its current membership, so a session that docks menus right does not trip it.

manual_reviewer_checklist.scope_note: The reservation and the refusal are machine-proven; how the placeholder reads on screen is the owner's call.

items.step: Look at the left column: the BUILDERS area is below PROJECTS.
items.machine_proven: B1: the reserved slot is in the left column at the documented last position, visible, never floating; the real-window receipt shows it last.
items.human_must_verify: The reserved area really sits under the Project Manager and stays there after resizing.

items.step: Click the BUILDERS bar and try to drag it.
items.machine_proven: Y1/B4: the click is refused with the documented message, the bar has no +/− box and no drag starts.
items.human_must_verify: Nothing moves, the message explains that Builders are reserved, and the cursor gives no hint that it could be dragged.

items.step: Try the placeholder's controls (New Emerald, Size, Show Diag., Reset, the slider, the icons).
items.machine_proven: B5/Y2: every widget in builder_slot_ui is disabled or hover-only (source scan), and the gem box senses hover only.
items.human_must_verify: None of them reacts, no popup opens, and the hover text says the operation is unavailable.

items.step: Draw geometry, then look at the BUILDERS area and the document.
items.machine_proven: B3/Y3: the placeholder is drawn from the layout only (no Document/Controller/builder type in its body); the slot creates no entities and no undo entries.
items.human_must_verify: There is no second Builder model: the object count, the layer list and Undo show only your drawing.

items.step: Edit a saved layout file so builder-slot is floating, hidden or above Projects, then start the app.
items.machine_proven: B6/Y4: the reservation is repaired back to the documented slot with a diagnostic naming 'Builders is reserved'.
items.human_must_verify: The app starts with the reserved area back below Projects and the status/history names the repair.
